data.text: Save me, God, by your name, and vindicate me by your might.
data.subtitulo: For the music director; with stringed instruments. A maskil of David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Is David not hiding among us?”

data.text: God, hear my prayer; listen to the words of my mouth.
For strangers have risen against me, and ruthless men seek my life; they have not set God before them. Selah.
Look, God is my helper; the Lord is among those who sustain my life.
data.titulo: The Help That Sustains the Persecuted

data.text: He will return evil upon those who watch for my downfall; in your faithfulness destroy them.
Willingly I will sacrifice to you; I will praise your name, LORD, for it is good.
For he has delivered me from every distress, and my eye has looked upon my enemies.
